main_text.p: Deum, 2 Et Mohammed Legatus Dei; at AlKodai-us horum ultimum tantum sigillo ipsius insculp-tum tradit, scil. الله محمد رسول الله Mohammed legatus Dei; ita ut tria continerent verba, totidem lineis descripta.

Filiam unicam Phatemam, &c.] De quâ ut & matre ejus quid ipse censuerit ex hoc ejus dicto pater (referente Abulfedâ) l.17. كمل من الرجال كثير وام تكمل من النسا الاربعة اسية زوجة فرعون ومريم بنت عمران وخديجة بنت خويلد وفاطمة بنت محمد Perfecti fuerunt è viris multi, at inter mulieres non reperta sunt perfecta præter quatuor, scil. Asiah uxorem Pharaonis, Miriam filiam Amrani, Chadijah filiam Chowailedi, & Phatemah filiam Mohammedis. Eadem autem illi Miriam, Mosis, & Aaronis soror (quicquid obtendant qui hanc ἀντιφρασίαν excusare conantur) cum Maria Beatâ Virgine.

In lege, isto textu, venit Deus è Sina & ortus est à Sair, & manifestatus à monte Paranis, &c.] Ita scil. verba ad Mohammedis legationem stabiliendam detorquent p.14.l.23. قن ورد في توريــة ان الله تعالي جاء من طور سيناء وظهر بساعير وعلن بفاران وساعير جبال بيت المقدس الذي كان مظهر عيسي عليه السلام وفاران جبال مكة التي كانت مظهر المصطفي Allatum est in lege, quòd Deus excelsus venerit à Sina, & apparuerit in Sair, & manifestatus fuerit in Paran. Sair autem montes sunt Hierosolymitani, qui locus fuit apparitionis Jesu, & Paran montes Meccæ qui locus fuerunt apparitionis Mostafæ, i. e. Mohammedi. Hæc AlSharestanius. Eadem ferè apud Safi-

page.notes: Arabic lines transcribed from the scan with some uncertainty about diacritics and the honorific marks; the Arabic shahada line and the superscript word above "محمد" are doubtful. The "2" after "Deum," may be a reference mark rather than a numeral. Italic and roman distinctions in the Latin are approximate at this resolution. The catchword is read as "oddinaui" and may be "oddinum". Google watermark at lower right excluded as digitiser's banner.
